presentation.metaDescription: Who XBZ Esport is: a competitive, organised and ambitious organisation, active on Rocket League.
presentation.title: Who are we?
presentation.intro: A competitive, organised and ambitious esports organisation — built to progress together on <game>Rocket League</game>.
presentation.pitch1: XBZ Esport is a fast-growing competitive organisation, created to bring together driven, serious and ambitious players around a shared goal: to improve and perform in esports.
presentation.pitch2: We are active on <game>Rocket League</game>, with a simple vision: build solid, consistent teams able to play at a genuinely competitive level.
presentation.pitch3: This isn’t just a community. It’s a structured organisation, with defined roles, an active staff and a real commitment to long-term growth.
presentation.pitch4: Every player, creator or staff member has an important part in how the project grows. Activity, motivation and team spirit are the foundations of XBZ.

competition.title: Competition
competition.text: Aiming high and performing in a demanding setting, match after match.

teamSpirit.title: Team spirit
teamSpirit.text: Playing together, helping each other and moving forward as a group rather than alone.

progression.title: Progression
progression.text: Levelling up, individually and as a team, over the long run.

ambition.title: Commitment & ambition
ambition.text: Steady involvement and a structured project that thinks big for the long term.

legal.metaDescription: Legal notice and information about the publisher of the XBZ Esport website.
legal.title: Legal notice
legal.publisherText: The {name} website is published by the esports organisation {name}.
legal.hostingText: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, United States — <vercel>vercel.com</vercel>.
legal.ipText: All content on this website (text, logo, visuals, layout) is the property of {name} unless stated otherwise. Any reproduction or reuse, in whole or in part, without prior permission is prohibited.
legal.dataText1: The recruitment and support forms only collect the information you provide, for the sole purpose of handling your request. This data is never sold or transferred to third parties.
legal.dataText2: Under the GDPR, you can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data by contacting us on the organisation’s Discord.
legal.dataText3: For the details (purposes, retention period, processors, rights), see our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
legal.cookiesText: This website uses no advertising or tracking cookies. Only technical cookies required to operate (back-office authentication session, remembering your chosen language) may be set.

privacy.metaDescription: How XBZ Esport collects, uses, stores and protects your personal data (recruitment and support), and how to exercise your GDPR rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data {name} collects through its forms, why, how long it is kept, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.controllerText: The data collected on this website is processed by the esports organisation {name}. For any question about your data, contact us <discord>on the official Discord server</discord><mail> or by email at </mail>.
privacy.collectedIntro: We only collect the information you provide voluntarily:

collected.recruitment: Recruitment form: category, desired role, full name, age, country of residence, Discord username, username, game, RL Tracker link (optional), experience and motivation (optional), preferred roster (optional).
collected.support: Support form: name or username, email address, subject and body of your message.
collected.antispam: Anti-spam protection: when a form is submitted, your IP address is briefly recorded to limit repeated submissions. It is never associated with the content of your message and is deleted automatically a few moments after sending.

privacy.collectedOutro: No sensitive data is requested. We use neither advertising cookies nor trackers (see the <legal>legal notice</legal>).
privacy.purposeText1: This data is used solely to process your application or to answer your support request, and to get back to you about it.
privacy.purposeText2: The legal basis for processing is your consent (GDPR article 6.1.a), collected via the checkbox on each form. That consent is timestamped when you submit.
privacy.purposeText3: The anti-spam protection described above relies instead on our legitimate interest (GDPR article 6.1.f) in protecting the site from automated submissions.
privacy.retentionText: Your data is kept for {months} months from the date you send it, then deleted automatically. You can request its deletion at any time before that (see “Your rights”).
privacy.recipientsText: Your data is accessible only to the {name} staff authorised to handle applications and support. It is never sold or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.processorsIntro: To operate, the website relies on the following technical providers:

processors.supabase: Supabase — hosting of the database where applications and messages are stored.
processors.vercel: Vercel — website hosting and anonymous audience measurement (aggregated visit statistics, no cookie and no individual tracking).
processors.discord: Discord — an internal notification is sent to the staff on the organisation’s server when a form is received.

privacy.rightsText: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and object to processing, the right to data portability, and the right to withdraw your consent at any time.
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise these rights, contact us <discord>on the official Discord server</discord><mail> or at </mail>. We will reply as soon as we can.
privacy.rightsComplaint: You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority — <cnil>cnil.fr</cnil>.
